scenario.name: Metro fibre degradation between core and data centre
scenario.description: The metro fibre between CORE-SW-01 and DC1-FW-01 degrades with low optical power, CRC errors and packet loss; every branch is affected for data centre services while internet access stays healthy. A congested but error-free New York WAN acts as a decoy.

incident.title: Slow ERP and intermittent login failures at every branch
incident.description: Users at New York, Singapore and Bengaluru report slow ERP, slow name resolution and occasional 802.1X re-authentication failures. Internet browsing feels normal. New York also reports slow file transfers.

ground_truth.root_cause: Optical degradation on the metro fibre circuit MET-DC1-0001 (LNK-CORE-DC1-METRO) between CORE-SW-01 Te1/0/4 and DC1-FW-01 ethernet1/1 causes CRC errors and 3-7% packet loss on all traffic between the core and the data centre.
